title: Protein expression in yeast
author: Jaclyn Winter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gahtse

steps.title: Prepare expression plasmid
steps.instruction: Linearize the 2 μm expression plasmid by digesting with Pml I and Nde I at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Transform S. cerevisiae
steps.instruction: Co-transform exons with the linearized expression plasmid into S. cerevisiae BJ5464-NpgA using an S. c EasyComp™ Transformation kit (Invitrogen) to yield expression plasmid pJW07638.

steps.title: Prepare seed culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a single transformant into 3 mL SDct media and grow for 72 hours with constant shaking at 28 °C.

substeps.instruction: Prepare SDct media using 0.5 g Bacto Technical grade cassamino acids, 2 g Dextrose, and 88 mL Milli-Q water

Supplement media with 1 mL adenine (40 mg/20 mL Milli-Q water), 1 mL tryptophan (40 mg/20 mL Milli-Q water), and 10 mL nitrogen base (1.7 g Nitrogen Base without amino acids, 5 g ammonium sulfate, and 100 mL Milli-Q water)

steps.title: Scale up culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 L of YPD supplemented with 1% dextrose using a 1 mL aliquot of the seed culture and shake at 28 °C for 72 hours.

substeps.instruction: Prepare YPD using 10 g yeast extract, 20 g peptone, and 950 mL Milli-Q water

steps.title: Harvest and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and disrupt them to release protein.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 3,750 rpm at 4 °C for 10 mins
Resuspend cell pellet in 30 mL lysis buffer (50 mM NaH2PO4, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.0)
Sonicate cells on ice in one minute intervals until homogenous

steps.title: Clear cellular debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenous mixture at 17,000 rpm for 1 hour at 4 °C to remove cellular debris.

steps.title: Bind protein to resin
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of Ni-NTA agarose resin to the supernatant and incubate at 4 °C for 12–16 hours.

steps.title: Purify soluble protein
steps.instruction: Purify soluble protein via gravity-flow column chromatography using increasing concentrations of imidazole in buffer A (50 mM Tris-HCl, 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM–250 mM imidazole, pH 7.9).

steps.title: Concentrate and store protein
steps.instruction: Concentrate and buffer exchange the purified protein into Buffer B and store in glycerol.

substeps.instruction: Use an Ultracel 100,000 MWCO centrifugal filter (Amicon Inc.) to concentrate and exchange into Buffer B (50 mM Tris-HCl, 2 mM EDTA, 100 mM NaCl, pH 8.0)
